hook.convey: a fraction drawn on a strip: cut every part smaller, or join parts into bigger ones → the coloured amount stays, only the numbers change → two names for one amount = tulya bhinn (class 5 folded halves; here thirds, quarters, fifths, and joining)

use.hi: Kitchen mein mummy roti ke hisse kabhi chhote kaatti hain, kabhi jod deti hain. Roti utni hi rehti hai.
use.en: In the kitchen Mummy sometimes cuts a roti's parts smaller, and sometimes joins them. The roti stays the same.

use.hi: Drawing sheet ke hisse chhote karo ya bade, rangeen jagah utni hi rehti hai.
use.en: Make the parts of a drawing sheet smaller or bigger; the coloured space stays the same.

explain.convey: strip in 3 equal parts, 1 coloured = 1/3; each part cut in 2 → 6 parts, 2 coloured = 2/6; the colour did not change → tulya bhinn; the card: a 3/4 strip on its own board, every part cut into 3 in the mind → the child names the new fraction

viewCaption.hi: Yahan dono pattiyan 0 se 1 ki ek line ban gayi hain, aur 1/3 aur 2/6 ke nishaan ek hi jagah par hain.
viewCaption.en: Here the two strips have become one line from 0 to 1, and the marks for 1/3 and 2/6 are at the same place.

point.hi: Upar 1/3 rangeen hai. Neeche har hissa 2 mein kata: 6 mein se 2, yaani 2/6. Rang utna hi hai, toh yeh tulya bhinn hain.
point.en: One third of the top strip is coloured. Below, every part is cut in 2, so 2 of 6 are coloured: 2/6. The colour is the same, so these are equivalent fractions.

pointAlt.hi: Socho upar wali patti ka har hissa beech se kaat diya. Hisse 6 ho gaye aur rangeen 2, par rang badla nahi: 1/3 aur 2/6 ek hi cheez ke do naam hain.
pointAlt.en: Picture every part of the top strip cut down the middle. There are now 6 parts and 2 coloured, but the colour did not change: 1/3 and 2/6 are two names for one thing.

prompt.hi: Ab socho, is 3/4 wali patti ke har hisse ko 3 barabar hisson mein kaata. Ab kitne mein se kitne hisse rangeen hain?
prompt.en: Now suppose every part of this 3/4 strip is cut into 3 equal parts. Now how many parts out of how many are coloured?

reask.hi: 3/4 wali patti ka har hissa 3 mein kata, toh naya bhinn kaunsa hai?
reask.en: Every part of the 3/4 strip is cut into 3: which is the new fraction?

did.hi: 3/4 ke har hisse ko 3 mein kaat kar naya bhinn nikala
did.en: cut every part of 3/4 into 3 and named the new fraction

viewCaption.hi: Yahan wahi patti ek gol roti ki tarah bani hai: 4 barabar hisse, aur 3 rangeen.
viewCaption.en: Here the same strip is drawn round like a roti: 4 equal parts, 3 coloured.

why.hi: 4 hisse 3-3 mein kate toh 12, aur 3 rangeen hisse 3 × 3 bane: 9/12
why.en: 4 parts cut in 3 each make 12, and the 3 coloured parts make 3 × 3: 9/12

whyShort.hi: har rangeen hissa bhi 3 mein kata
whyShort.en: every coloured part was cut into 3 too

whyAlt.hi: Kaatne par rangeen hisse bhi kat-te hain: woh utne hi nahi rehte, har ek 3 chhote hisse ban jaata hai.
whyAlt.en: Cutting cuts the coloured parts too: they do not stay as many, each one becomes 3 small parts.

simpler.hi: Pehle socho, 4 hisse 3-3 mein kate toh kul kitne bane. Phir rangeen hisson ke saath bhi wahi socho.
simpler.en: First think how many parts 4 parts make when each is cut into 3. Then think the same for the coloured parts.

hindi.hi: 3/4 wali patti ka har hissa 3 chhote hisson mein baant do. Poori patti mein ab kul kitne bane, aur unmein rang wale kitne?
hindi.en: Split every part of the 3/4 strip into 3 small parts. How many are there now in the whole strip, and how many of them have colour?

simpler.hi: Hisse kaatne se rangeen jagah nahi badalti, sirf hisse chhote aur zyada ho jaate hain. Isliye 1/3 aur 2/6 tulya bhinn hain.
simpler.en: Cutting the parts does not change the coloured space; the parts only get smaller and more. So 1/3 and 2/6 are equivalent fractions.

explain.convey: the reverse: a strip in 6 parts, 4 coloured; join the parts in twos → 3 bigger parts, 2 coloured → 4/6 = 2/3; the card: 8 of 10 coloured, joined in twos, on its own board → the child names the new fraction

viewCaption.hi: Yahan dono pattiyan 0 se 1 ki ek line ban gayi hain; 4/6 aur 2/3 ke nishaan ek hi jagah hain.
viewCaption.en: Here the two strips have become one line from 0 to 1; the marks for 4/6 and 2/3 are at one place.

point.hi: Ulta bhi hota hai. Upar 6 mein se 4 hisse rangeen hain. Do-do hisse jodo, toh 3 bade hisse bante hain aur 2 rangeen: 4/6 = 2/3.
point.en: It works the other way too. On top, 4 of 6 parts are coloured. Join the parts in twos, and 3 big parts form, 2 of them coloured: 4/6 = 2/3.

pointAlt.hi: Ab chhote hisse jod kar bade banao. 6 chhote hisse do-do jude toh 3 bade bane, aur 4 rangeen jude toh 2. Rang wahi raha.
pointAlt.en: Now join small parts into big ones. 6 small parts joined in twos make 3 big ones, and the 4 coloured make 2. The colour stayed the same.

reask.hi: 10 mein se 8 rangeen hisse do-do jode, toh kaunsa bhinn bana?

did.hi: 10 mein se 8 rangeen hisse do-do jod kar naya bhinn nikala

viewCaption.hi: Yahan wahi patti ek gol roti ki tarah bani hai: 10 barabar hisse, aur 8 rangeen.

why.hi: 10 hisse do-do jud kar 5 bade hisse, aur 8 rangeen jud kar 4: 4/5
why.en: 10 parts joined in twos make 5 big parts, and the 8 coloured make 4: 4/5

whyShort.hi: rangeen aur kul, dono do-do jude
whyShort.en: the coloured and all parts joined in twos

whyAlt.hi: Jodne par poori patti ke hisse bhi judte hain; neeche 10 nahi rehta, kyunki bade hisse 10 nahi bante.
whyAlt.en: Joining joins the parts of the whole strip too; the bottom does not stay 10, because there are not 10 big parts.

simpler.hi: Pehle gino, 10 hisse do-do jud kar kitne bade hisse bante hain. Phir rangeen hisse bhi do-do jodo.
simpler.en: First count how many big parts 10 parts make when joined in twos. Then join the coloured parts in twos too.

simpler.hi: Do-do hisse jodne se hisse bade aur kam ho jaate hain, par rang utna hi rehta hai. Isliye 4/6 aur 2/3 tulya hain.
simpler.en: Joining parts in twos makes the parts bigger and fewer, but the colour stays the same. So 4/6 and 2/3 are equivalent.

explain.convey: bigger numbers are not a bigger amount: 1/4 cut in 3 → 3/12, bigger numbers, the same colour; the card: Reena 3/5 of a roti, Mohit 9/15 of the same roti → who ate more, or the same

viewCaption.hi: Yahan dono pattiyan 0 se 1 ki ek line ban gayi hain; 1/4 aur 3/12 ke nishaan ek hi jagah par hain.
viewCaption.en: Here the two strips have become one line from 0 to 1; the marks for 1/4 and 3/12 are at the same place.

point.hi: Bade numbers matlab bada bhinn nahi. 1/4 ke har hisse ko 3 mein kaato, toh 3/12 banta hai: numbers bade hain, par rang utna hi.
point.en: Bigger numbers do not mean a bigger fraction. Cut every part of 1/4 into 3 and you get 3/12: the numbers are bigger, but the colour is the same.

pointAlt.hi: 3/12 mein 3 aur 12 bade dikhte hain, par uske hisse 1/4 ke hisson se chhote hain. Isliye zyada hisse milkar bhi utna hi rang banta hai.
pointAlt.en: In 3/12 the 3 and 12 look bigger, but its parts are smaller than the parts of 1/4. So more parts together still make the same colour.

prompt.en: Reena ate 2/3 of a roti, Mohit 8/12 of a roti just like it. Who ate more, or did both eat the same?

why.en: Join Mohit's parts in fours: 12 make 3 big parts, 8 make 2. 8/12 = 2/3, so both ate the same

whyAlt.hi: Mohit ke numbers isliye bade hain ki uski roti ke hisse chhote the; chhote hisse zyada gine, par roti zyada nahi hui.

hindi.en: There are two identical rotis. Reena has 2/3 of one and Mohit 8/12 of the other: who has more roti, or do both have as much?

simpler.hi: Hisse chhote hon toh ginti badh jaati hai, par rang wahi rehta hai. Numbers dekh kar bhinn bada mat samjho.
simpler.en: When the parts are smaller the count grows, but the colour stays the same. Do not take a fraction as bigger from its numbers.

do.en: Join the first strip's parts in twos

steps.result: 12 hisse teen-teen jud kar 4 bade hisse

why.hi: 24 aur 33 dono 3 se bat-te hain: 24 ÷ 3 = 8, 33 ÷ 3 = 11, toh 8/11
why.en: 24 and 33 both divide by 3: 24 ÷ 3 = 8, 33 ÷ 3 = 11, so 8/11

whyShort.hi: 8/11 ko aage bhaag nahi kar sakte

whyAlt.hi: 24/33 aakhri nahi: 24 aur 33 dono abhi 3 ki table mein hain.
whyAlt.en: 24/33 is not the end: 24 and 33 are both still in the 3 times table.

simpler.hi: 24/33 ke upar aur neeche ka common factor dhoondo aur bhaag do. Phir jaancho, kuch common bacha toh nahi.
simpler.en: Find a common factor of the top and bottom of 24/33 and divide. Then check whether anything common is left.

remediation.move: one strip in 12 parts with 9 coloured, said as 9/12, and the same amount named 3/4 → the numbers of 9/12 are bigger only because its parts are smaller; the then-card: 6/8 vs 15/20 (left to the child)

viewCaption.hi: Yahan dono pattiyan do gol roti ban gayi hain: pehli baarah hisson mein, doosri chaar mein, aur rang dono mein utna hi.
viewCaption.en: Here both strips have become two round rotis: the first in twelve parts, the second in four, with the same colour on both.

say.hi: Jis bhinn ke hisse chhote hon, uske numbers bade hote hain, par rang utna hi reh sakta hai. Isliye numbers nahi, lowest terms milao.
say.en: A fraction with smaller parts has bigger numbers, yet its colour can be the same. So compare lowest terms, not the numbers.

simpler.hi: Numbers dekh kar faisla mat karo. Dono bhinn ko lowest terms mein lao, phir milao.
simpler.en: Do not decide by the numbers. Bring both fractions to lowest terms, then compare.

sayAlt.hi: Ek hi roti ko 4 hisson mein kaato ya 12 mein, roti wahi rehti hai. 12 hisson mein se 9 aur 4 mein se 3, dono utni hi roti hai.
sayAlt.en: Cut one roti into 4 parts or into 12, it is the same roti. 9 of 12 parts and 3 of 4 are the same amount of roti.

prompt.hi: 6/8 aur 15/20 mein bada kaunsa hai, ya dono barabar?
prompt.en: Which is bigger, 6/8 or 15/20, or are they the same?

reask.hi: 6/8 aur 15/20: kaun bada, ya barabar?
reask.en: 6/8 and 15/20: which is bigger, or the same?

viewCaption.hi: Yahan wahi patti ek gol roti ki tarah bani hai: 8 barabar hisse, aur 6 rangeen.
viewCaption.en: Here the same strip is drawn round like a roti: 8 equal parts, 6 coloured.

why.hi: 6/8 ko 2 se bhaag do toh 3/4, aur 15/20 ko 5 se toh 3/4: dono barabar
why.en: divide 6/8 by 2 and you get 3/4, and 15/20 by 5 gives 3/4: the same

whyAlt.hi: 15/20 ke numbers isliye bade hain ki uske hisse chhote hain; isse bhinn bada nahi hota.
whyAlt.en: 15/20 has bigger numbers because its parts are smaller; that does not make the fraction bigger.

simpler.hi: 6/8 aur 15/20, dono ko lowest terms mein likho, aur dekho kya bana.
simpler.en: Write both 6/8 and 15/20 in lowest terms, and see what comes.

covered.hi: Aakhir mein bhinn ko common factor se bhaag dete gaye, jab tak sirf 1 common bacha: lowest terms.
covered.en: Last we kept dividing a fraction by common factors until only 1 was common: lowest terms.

prompt.hi: Ek dabbe ke 27 laddoo mein se 21 meethe hain, doosre ke 36 mein se 28. Dono dabbon ke meethe laddoo ka bhinn lowest terms mein kya hai?
prompt.en: In one box 21 of 27 laddoos are sweet, in another 28 of 36. What is the fraction of sweet laddoos for both boxes in lowest terms?

reask.hi: 21/27 aur 28/36, dono lowest terms mein kya hain?
reask.en: What are 21/27 and 28/36 in lowest terms?

did.hi: do dabbon ke bhinn lowest terms mein laakar milaye
did.en: brought two boxes' fractions to lowest terms and compared them

why.hi: 21/27 ko 3 se bhaag do toh 7/9, aur 28/36 ko 4 se toh 7/9. Dono dabbon mein bhinn ek hi hai.
why.en: Divide 21/27 by 3 and you get 7/9, and 28/36 by 4 gives 7/9. The fraction is the same in both boxes.

simpler.hi: Pehle 21/27 ke upar aur neeche ka common factor dhoondo aur bhaag do. Phir 28/36 ke saath bhi yahi karo.
simpler.en: First find a common factor of the top and bottom of 21/27 and divide. Then do the same with 28/36.

leadIn.hi: Chalo, ab poore paath se ek aakhri sawaal.
leadIn.en: Now, one last question from the whole lesson.

leadIn.hi: Aaj ki saari baatein jodne wala ek aakhri sawaal aa raha hai.
leadIn.en: One last question is coming that pulls together everything from today.

leadIn.hi: Bas ek sawaal aur bacha hai, aur woh poore paath par hai.
leadIn.en: Just one more question is left, and it is about the whole lesson.

viewCaption.hi: Board par baayein pehle dabbe ka 21/27 hai, aur daayein doosre ka 28/36.
viewCaption.en: On the board, on the left, is the first box's 21/27, and on the right the second's 28/36.

pictureCaption.hi: Yahan pehle dabbe ke 27 laddoo hain, nau-nau ki 3 qataar mein.
pictureCaption.en: Here are the first box's 27 laddoos, in 3 rows of nine.

covered.hi: Aaj dekha ki hisse kaatne ya jodne se bhinn utna hi rehta hai. Phir upar-neeche ko ek number se guna ya bhaag karke bhinn lowest terms tak le gaye.
covered.en: Today we saw that cutting or joining parts keeps a fraction the same. Then by multiplying or dividing top and bottom by one number we took fractions to lowest terms.

goodbye.hi: Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain.
goodbye.en: That's all for today, see you again soon.
